verdict.rationale: Floot exposes an official remote MCP server with a rich tool set (get_logs, query_database, execute_sql, create_checkpoint, generate_image, pull_database_schema) that lets AI assistants programmatically build and manage apps, which is a genuine programmatic interface for ai-native use (floot-docs-3,4,5,7,floot-probe-4). However, probes found no traditional REST/OpenAPI platform API (docs.md and openapi.json all 404), so programmatic access is limited to the MCP protocol rather than a general-purpose platform API. Missing for 10: a documented REST/OpenAPI API, SDKs, and evidence of broader programmatic app-management beyond MCP tool calls.
